name: v157_option_dividend_fcf_cap55_subindustry
hypothesis: The v156 FCF-breadth fusion was strong but LOW_SUB_UNIVERSE blocked. A moderate cap gate and subindustry ranking may preserve cashflow-visibility information while reducing small-cap dependence.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.55, 0.290 * group_rank(ts_rank(option_award_expected_dividend_rate, 126), subindustry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_fcf_number, 63), 126), subindustry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_fcf_high / abs(assets) - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_fcf_low / abs(assets)), 126), subindustry) + 0.110 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.090 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Direct LSUS repair of Jjpz9zWO; stop if metrics collapse.
